item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - TOMORA 2026-07-25 live Fuji Rock Festival with decent quality
item.description:
TOMORA 2026-07-25 live Fuji Rock Festival (1080p or better)

If you don't know their music, it's Chemical Brothers + AURORA and is quite awesome!

I think this performance was on twitch at 6Mbps and amazon music at a higher bitrate. User AURORA Fan Channel on Youtube has a glitch free recording (), possibly a screen recording to lossless codec. I'm trying to get in contact for a higher bitrate recording.

There's this one but it has a major glitch at 20:50 and judder throughout and looks to be encoded with NVENC:


Has anyone found a decent quality recording of this performance? Twitch is often poor even at 6Mbps, and amazon music is hit or miss, plus you need to be in a release group to do a stream capture. A screen recording to lossless codec later recompressed at say 40 Mbps with x264 or x265 can look excellent and be suitable for remastering with AI.
